crime: Trimming her little sister's fringe at the kitchen table, {WITCH_NAME} pictured closing the scissors on that small throat. Her hand stopped. Her mother took them: "What's wrong with your face?" After that she smiled at everyone. Such a girl must never be looked at closely.

Every Sunday a prisoner cut the girls' hair on a stool in the courtyard, as she had for her little brother. In her apron, she pinned a white cape at each girl's throat. {WITCH_NAME} always smiled and declined her turn.

One Sunday the barber gave her the scissors and tipped her own head back: "Your turn. An inch off my fringe." She stopped, blades open at the barber's throat. The barber laughed to the waiting line: "She's shaking! From now on she does my fringe every Sunday till her hands are steady." Every girl looked at those hands.

When the others went in, she asked to try the fringe again and drove the scissors into the barber's side under the apron. The barber met her smile; her Magic loosened her shoulders. "It's only a nick." The barber pocketed her scissors and followed {WITCH_NAME} in.
In the lounge the barber sat quiet by her until lockup; each time she looked up, {WITCH_NAME} was smiling. Nobody noticed.
At lockup the barber hung her apron outside her barred cell door to keep hair out. She called goodnight across the cell corridor to the smiling {WITCH_NAME} and took her scissors in.
Her roommate woke to find her dead in a blood-soaked blanket, the scissors bloody on the floor. The prisoners blamed the roommate, locked in with her all night.

But that morning a prisoner had turned over the apron on the door: a slit in its side, dried blood inside. Now the prisoners saw: the barber, stabbed through it before lockup, said goodnight calmly because {WITCH_NAME} smiled at her all evening.
fields.epitaph: Her hands were only ever steady when it was real.
fields.epithet: A Steady Smile Over a Shaking Hand
execution: A tall haircut stool stands in the trial court. She is strapped to its seat, a white cape pinned at her throat and its hem pinned to the floor all the way round.
The stool rises slowly. The cape draws taut from floor to throat, and its collar tightens.
As the collar tightens, she smiles at the spectators. Their faces soften and their shoulders loosen, at ease.
The stool stops high above the court. The cape is a still white tent from her throat to the floor, and the spectators sit at ease.

magic.name: All Is Well
magic.text: Any person or animal who sees her smile is instantly calmed, sure that all is well.

crime: Every evening, one girl floated on her back out on the lake until dusk, and she asked {WITCH_NAME} to come along and keep her shoes on the shore. Back home she had floated on the river whenever her head got too loud. While she floated, she never answered anyone.
One night in the dining hall, she told the whole table, "From tomorrow, she's going to hold my head while I float. She won't let go." {WITCH_NAME} smiled and said, "Of course."
The next evening, as free time began, {WITCH_NAME} knelt at the water's edge. The girl lay back in the shallows, laid her head in {WITCH_NAME}'s hands and closed her eyes. "Don't let go."
When {WITCH_NAME} was ten, bathing her baby brother, she had pictured pushing his head under. She lifted him out into a white towel, and she had kept her hands out of water ever since.

Now she pressed the girl down by the shoulders and held her under until she was still. With her Magic she turned the soaked dress into buoyant foam that still looked like wet cloth, then pushed the girl out face up onto the open water.

Between half past five and half past six, the prisoners came down to the shore and saw her floating out on the lake as she did every evening, with {WITCH_NAME} on the shore keeping her shoes. {WITCH_NAME} walked up to dinner with them. At dusk they found the girl drowned in the shallows, with hand marks on her shoulders.

In the trial court, everyone agreed that someone had held her under after half past six, while {WITCH_NAME} sat at dinner with them. Then a prisoner touched the hem of the dress, which still looked soaked. Her palm came away dry, and the cloth sprang back like foam. The dress had been made into a float while it was wet. The girl had been dead before they ever reached the shore, and only {WITCH_NAME} had been beside her.
fields.epitaph: That picture never had to come true. It did because she kept it hidden.
fields.epithet: The gentle big sister, afraid of her own hands
execution: A child's bathtub rises, grown to her size. She lies strapped on her back inside it, dry. A white bath towel drops and settles over her, soft and fluffy. Then it turns to marble. It still looks soft, but its weight presses down on her chest. Her fingers push at the hem and go still. The towel lies over the tub, white and soft-looking.

magic.name: Skin Deep
magic.text: She can change what any object is made of, while it keeps looking exactly the same.
